scientific_integrity: An analytical proof establishes the unlimited differentiability, exact jet, sharp growth and off-origin analyticity; the numerical checker is supportive only.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional drift-free diffusion at strictly positive diffusion and resetting rates and a fixed nonzero contraction with magnitude below one.
No assertion for complete resetting, unit-magnitude multipliers, finite-time laws or other noise models.

The stationary density, pantograph equation and Laplace-series representation are existing published results; only the all-order derivative jet and analyticity classification are the assessed contribution.
An unindexed general pantograph smoothness theorem might imply the finding; scientific novelty is not independently certified.
title: Smooth but nowhere Gevrey at the reset point: the stationary density of proportional Brownian resetting
